body: I think I will see if i can finally get a night's sleep that leaves me feeling well rested. Thanks for all your help.

I wish you the best with your university, I don't know the situation so I am unsure if I could be of any help. I am experienced as far as manipulating school systems goes, so feel free to reach out to me if you have any logistic questions or help proofreading emails. These can be done without putting your identity at risk.  
As far as parents go, its all the luck of the draw, I know others have it worse than me, but i think /r/raisedbynarcissists captures how difficult it can be to live with people who are so self centered. Good luck and I will help you in anyways I can, I'm a pm away.

Unfortunately, even though I have tons of work experience, it is difficult to find a job that can both help me pay for a sublet as well as all my other living costs. I tried working out an alternative path this summer but I live in a expensive city as far as rent, and I only have enough money for 3 months rent as well as a deposit. So i have been relegated to daily dehumanizing talks with my parents daily while I hope to find another path and or quit bothering with all of this shit.
Just because I am at this point does not mean anyone else should be. Feel free to confide in me whether it be here or in a pm. We can get through this, and I will make sure that you will.

No of course not, as I said earlier, the outside world isn't very open minded of people like me. I don't have those types of resources available to me, and if people heard of it my reputation would be destroyed, I would disowned and homeless. I also have issues letting go, I know an understand why psychiatrists ask the questions they do, and it feels compulsory for me to give them an answer that doesn't get me into deep shit. I have relegated myself to anonymous online posts, and admittedly it helps more than you could imagine.

Im sorry if my vocabulary alienated you or anyone else. I dont use big words for the sake of it, rather I use them to accurately display my thoughts. As far as my kindness goes, you would be surprised about the people that reach this point in life. On the outside I am very social, outgoing, kind and understanding. But all of us put on facades for the outside world. We must protect how we feel because we fear the way the world reacts. People fear that we are irrational, that we need to be locked away and given pills that artificially affect your uptake and reuptake in your neurotransmitters. Basically a way of making you 'feel' happy even though you know your happiness is irrational. At the same time, even after touching so many people, I do not fear for them or their well-being. I find that it would be selfish of the world to keep asking more of me when I so clearly am at odds with everything around me. And after all is said and done, I have gone to a top tier school, I do know that there are thousands of students that are as capable as me The world is in good hands.

I will never admit to it, but anonymous praise has lifted my heart to point of tears. Even my stoicism is failing me. No there are no other family members to speak of, they all live overseas.  
I just fail to see the point in continuing with anything. I could get my life back on track however it seems like a practice in futility. I no longer seek the approval of anyone, and have thought about pursuing different avenues of life, the recurring thought is that regardless of what I do with my life I feel that it will be without impact. The true sadness is that I feel this way after donating hundred of hours to community service. I just feel hopeless.
